reviews.contract_reason: Old copy_bytes explicitly may copy a whole word for a one-byte request. Concat advances its destination in actual bytes, not rounded words, and its fixed-bytes branch also STOREs a full word. Thus even two short operands can place the last full-word store beyond ceil32(logical total). Old allocation/allocator and internal function/return conventions permit adjacent live EVM frame data; preventing its corruption is an existing compiler memory-layout duty, not new concat support.
